snippet.title: Prismhold - Official Trailer | Every Tower Is a Card | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Every tower is a card. Draft, merge and evolve 196 towers across 14 elements in a card-driven tower defense.
Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5421610/Prismhold/

🃏 Build your deck, then draft towers from the shop every wave
🔺 Merge three copies to evolve them, with no cap: III, IV, V and beyond
⚡ 14 elements, from dragon breath and chain lightning to black holes and falling stars
👑 A crowned boss every 10th wave, flying waves and 200 creatures
🤝 Play solo, team up with a friend on one map, or go Side by Side with up to 6 players
♾️ 10 maps, an endless ladder of levels, augments, a daily challenge, Steam leaderboards and 47 achievements

Try the free demo on Steam, or play it right in your browser: https://aca-games.itch.io/prismhold
Subscribe to ACA Games to follow along.

More from ACA Games:
🐠 ARC Aquarium: a cozy aquarium where every fish is a card (out now, free demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4213290/ARC_Aquarium/
⚔️ Quartermark: an idle RPG where your party fights on its own (out now, free demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/5061040/Quartermark/

#indiegame #towerdefense #deckbuilder
